trap.label: passiva em avisos
trap.wrong: A mistake did in your order. It have been corrected. A new package will send.
trap.right: A mistake was made in your order. It has been corrected. A new package will be sent.
trap.why: Em português “houve um erro” e “será enviado um pacote” usam voz impessoal. Em inglês a passiva exige be + particípio; o brasileiro omite o be (will send) ou usa have no lugar de has been.

mcq.q: We apologize: a mistake ___ in your bill.
To inform that it is fixed: “It ___ corrected.”

fix.wrong: Your parcel will deliver on Monday.
fix.right: Your parcel will be delivered on Monday.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a passiva: “We will send a new package.”
rewrite.answer: A new package will be sent.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a passiva: “We have corrected the error.”
Passe para a passiva: “Someone made a mistake.”
